review.subtitle: Bulova Lunar Pilot chronograph, 45 mm, black dial, tachymeter, black NATO strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: case length in the render (52.8 listed)
notes: Modelled: polished cushion case with the pushers at 2 and 4, polished bezel ring, applied indices with polished frames and lume (double bar at 12, wide at 3, 6 and 9), white lume hour and minute batons in polished frames, white chrono hand with a lozenge, white subdial hands, fluted crown, NATO strap with the house curl.

From the photo maps: black dial with BULOVA, the three subdials with their grooves and numerals, 262 kHz, the minute-track flange and the black tachymeter ring; the NATO strap texture with its keepers.
Under the hands and indices the dial is filled from the dial around them; it is covered by the 3D parts.
Scale is Bulova's 45 mm case width from the official straight-on render. Heights are a front-relief reading of the listed 10.3 mm.
